patch.value: Gate CI on pm health so a silently discarded peer edit cannot merge

CI runs the pm health command with the strict-exit flag immediately after npm ci; the gate uses pm health rather than pm validate, because pm validate returns ok:true after a same-field merge silently discards a peer edit; the strict-exit flag is present so an ok:false health result fails the build

Added the pm health strict-exit CI step immediately after Install dependencies. Verified the gate exits 0 on a clean tree and exits 1 naming the affected item under pending_merge_decision_items on a reproduced same-field merge that discarded a peer title edit.

author: codex

patch.value: Added the CI tracked-state health gate, corrected workflow and changelog language after Greptile identified the fresh-clone receipt boundary, retained local receipt reconciliation as a pre-push requirement, and filed pm-cli#921 with 2026.8.6 black-box evidence.

CI runs pm health --strict-exit immediately after dependency installation; clean durable repository state exits 0; tracked history, attribution, cache, extension, or available merge-evidence failures block CI; documentation does not claim fresh CI can inspect clone-local receipts

Run pm health --strict-exit in CI to reject durable tracker-health failures. The fresh runner cannot inspect clone-local merge receipts; pm-cli#921 tracks the remaining attestation gap, so receipt reconciliation stays a local pre-push responsibility.
Gate CI on strict tracked pm project health
Added a strict tracked-state health gate and corrected the merge-safety boundary after exact reviewer feedback.
CI rejects durable pm project-health failures without overstating coverage of clone-local merge receipts.

Package health passes locally. Published pm 2026.8.6 black-box proof showed pending receipts disappear in a fresh clone, durable history drift blocks the unrepaired merge, and history-repair can erase that last CI signal; upstream pm-cli#921 records the gap.

value.author: codex
value.text: Greptile P1 was valid as a scope correction: a fresh checkout cannot inspect .git-local receipts. The gate remains useful for durable health and catches unrepaired lossy merges through history drift,but it is not a complete no-loss guarantee.

message: Correct the CI gate contract after fresh-clone black-box proof
